inputs.original_text: South African actress Terry Pheto has once again been drawn into controversy after new details emerged in Parliament linking her to alleged financial misconduct involving the National Lotteries Commission (NLC). The revelations were presented during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. The session [...] The post Terry Pheto Linked To R20.56 Million NLC Funding Scandal In SIU Probe appeared first on SurgeZirc SA .
inputs.modified_text: Once more, we witness the predictable fallout from discarding personal responsibility and the traditional standards of integrity that once anchored our societies. South African actress Terry Pheto has been drawn back into controversy after new details emerged linking her to alleged financial misconduct involving R20.56 million from the National Lotteries Commission in an SIU probe. These revelations were presented during a briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. This is exactly what happens when we abandon those foundations in favor of unaccountable modern institutions that erode our social order and national values.
